results.title: In Search of the Present Mobile Guide - EMMA
results.content: **This mobile guide includes brief videos of artists’ interviews and pictures of each of the 22 works in the exhibition. *Machine Hallucinations: Nature Dreams* emerges from Refik Anadol Studio’s long-term research project at the intersection of architecture, AI-based digital art and environmental studies. She wanted to make visible the human labour involved in compiling the database for the artificial intelligence used in the video work. In the installation *Parent Matter*, 3D-animations of soil generation are combined with natural materials formed by humans and geological forces. This series of works is part of an artistic analysis carried out by Kurant in which she examines how value is created in a capitalist system and how the concept of work is changing. While the artist uses virtual reality in his work, his aim is to make technology invisible and to use it to enhance the bodily experience of the work’s content. In the EVE team AI researchers and metaverse artists develop love algorithms in a world of virtual reality and artificial intelligence.
